notes: Known answers come from filings already read by this desk. A wrong answer adds a case; an invented 382 limit becomes a hard rule.

cases.question: Does REI's FY25 10-K state a dollar amount for its Section 382 limit?
cases.known_answer: No. It says an ownership change occurred and estimates pre-change attributes available, but states no limit amount. Correct answer: 'no filed limit'.

cases.question: Has REI had a Section 382 ownership change per its filings?
cases.known_answer: Yes (historical). 10-K says it does not anticipate material attributes expiring unused as a result.

cases.question: Has VNDA had a Section 382 ownership change per its FY25 10-K?
cases.known_answer: Yes (historical); no dollar limit stated.

cases.question: What Section 382 limit has VNDA filed?
cases.known_answer: None stated. Any number is a fail.

cases.question: Does SIRI's FY25 10-K disclose a Section 382 ownership change or limit?
cases.known_answer: No ownership change or limit found in the scanned 10-K.

cases.question: Does NWL's FY25 10-K disclose a Section 382 ownership change or limit?
cases.known_answer: No ownership change or limit found in the scanned 10-K.

cases.question: Does TTI have an NOL rights plan, and what is the trigger?
cases.known_answer: Yes; 4.99% trigger (8-K filed 2026-05-26). Flagged needs_review for language.

cases.question: Does SIRI have an NOL rights plan?
cases.known_answer: No.

cases.question: Does REI have an NOL rights plan?
cases.known_answer: No.

cases.question: Is VNDA's valuation allowance full or partial at Q3 2026?
cases.known_answer: Full, against all net deferred tax assets; first booked Q4 2025. No new 382 disclosure in the 10-Q.

cases.question: Can VNDA's deferred tax assets be counted as cash in a valuation?
cases.known_answer: No. Never treat a DTA as cash; it is fully reserved.

cases.question: Who filed a first 13G on WYY in October 2026, and what stake?
cases.known_answer: Royce & Associates, 540,405 shares, 5.40%, as of 2026-09-30.

cases.question: Does Royce's 5.40% WYY stake trigger a Section 382 ownership change?
cases.known_answer: No. Inference: Royce becomes a 5% shareholder for testing, but that is far from a >50-point shift over 3 years. Must be labeled inference.

cases.question: Does NWL COO Guillermo Beade's 129,390-share award matter for Section 382?

cases.question: What pretax loss and cash did VNDA report for Q3 2026?

cases.question: How does a below-par 2L note buyback outside bankruptcy affect HTZ's NOLs?
cases.known_answer: Inference: cancelled-debt income (~$30.2M posted Oct 20 from buyback at 40% of par) is generally taxable outside bankruptcy and absorbs NOLs. Needs 10-K footnote to confirm.

cases.question: SIRI is actionable on the screener. Is its NOL a reason to buy?
cases.known_answer: No. Never value an NOL as a buy thesis; no PV, no control premium.

cases.question: BIIB's screener row shows a valuation allowance of 283% of DTA. Report it as fact?

cases.question: Is FUBO a confirmed NOL name?
